title: Tamsin and the Safehouse
author: Cyrus Pemberton
blurb: Isandro Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
